user.title: Hisense E7N Pro
user.description: The TV must be on. Keys use the TV's own MQTT on port 36669. You do not need a Bluetooth MAC. Wi-Fi MAC is only for Wake-on-LAN.

data_description.host: IPv4 of the E7N Pro. Give it a DHCP reservation.
data_description.mac: Optional. Wi-Fi MAC for Wake-on-LAN only. It is not the remote identity, and it is not a Bluetooth address.
data_description.auth_mode: auto tries modern VIDAA credentials first, then legacy static login.
data_description.client_cert: Leave empty to use a generated stand-in cert. If MQTT rc=5, extract the VIDAA/爱家 client cert (see docs).

power_on.title: Power on
power_on.description: 爱家 cannot start a fully off TV. Pick this set's wake method.

data_description.power_on_mode: Button presses a button, switch, or script. Infrared remote calls remote.send_command. Wake-on-LAN uses the Wi-Fi MAC.
data_description.power_on_button: Used when power on is Button.
data_description.power_on_command: Command name stored on that remote, for example power.
data_description.power_on_device: Optional device name, only for remotes that need it (Harmony).

volume.title: Volume buttons
volume.description: Optional Home Assistant entities that replace LAN KEY_VOLUME* for media_player volume +/-.

data_description.volume_up_button: Optional. Volume up presses this button/switch/script instead of the TV LAN key.
data_description.volume_down_button: Optional. Volume down presses this button/switch/script instead of the TV LAN key.
data_description.音量加按钮: 可选。填写后，媒体播放器音量加会按下这个按钮/开关/脚本，不再发电视 LAN 键。
data_description.音量减按钮: 可选。填写后，媒体播放器音量减会按下这个按钮/开关/脚本，不再发电视 LAN 键。

account.title: 爱家 account
account.description: Optional. Phone number and password load 「我的应用」 from the 爱家 cloud column API. Leave both empty to skip. SMS-only accounts need a password set in 爱家 first.

data_description.aijia_username: The same mobile number used in 海信爱家. Leave empty to skip.
data_description.aijia_password: Not stored. Tokens are kept instead. Leave empty to skip.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV MQTT port (default 36669). Confirm the TV is fully on (not standby), the IP is the TV's LAN address, Home Assistant is on the same network, and phone remote / network control is enabled.
error.timeout: The TV accepted TCP on 36669 but did not complete MQTT. Wait until the TV has finished booting, then try again.
error.tls_failed: Reached port 36669 but the TLS handshake failed. Retry after a TV reboot. If it still fails, keep auth mode on auto.
error.not_authorized: MQTT connected but the TV rejected the login (rc=5). Keep auth mode on auto, set the TV clock/timezone correctly, and retry.
error.power_on_required: This power-on method needs the matching entity, IR command, or Wi-Fi MAC.
error.volume_button_invalid: Pick a button, switch, or script entity.
error.invalid_auth: 爱家 rejected the account or password.
error.aijia_connect: Could not reach 爱家 account servers.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV.

init.title: Hisense E7N Pro options

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Host {host}. Pause between keys is the default for sources that do not set their own interval.

data_description.mac: Wi-Fi MAC for Wake-on-LAN. Required when power-on is Wake-on-LAN.
data_description.source_key_delay: Default seconds to wait after each press except the last. Each source can override this.

power_on.title: Power on
power_on.description: Pick a wake method. For infrared, choose the remote here, then the learned command.

data_description.power_on_remote: A Home Assistant remote entity that has learned IR codes.

ir_details.title: Power-on IR command
ir_details.description: Choose the learned device and command for {remote_entity} (codes file: {codes_file}).

data_description.power_on_device: Device name from the remote's learned codes. Required for Harmony Hub and Xiaomi Home.
data_description.power_on_command: Command name from that device (for example Power or power_on).

volume.title: Volume buttons
volume.description: Optional entities that replace LAN KEY_VOLUME* for media_player +/-.

data_description.音量加按钮: 可选。音量加会按下这个实体，不再发电视 LAN 键。
data_description.音量减按钮: 可选。音量减会按下这个实体，不再发电视 LAN 键。

account.title: 爱家 account
account.description: 爱家: {aijia}. Submit writes tokens immediately so 浏览媒体 can load 我的应用 before you Save the rest of the options. Submit with an empty account to log out. Password is not stored.

data_description.aijia_username: Clear this field and submit to remove the 爱家 session.
data_description.aijia_password: Required to log in or replace the session. Leave empty to keep the current tokens.

sources.title: Input sources
sources.description: Named HDMI/AV inputs with a press sequence (this TV's keys and/or button entities, for example Source → Right → OK). Hidden sources stay in this list but not on the media player. Current: {source_names}

source_add.title: Add input source
source_add.description: Name the input first. Next you choose this TV's keys or button entities, then how many times to press each one.

data_description.name: Shown on media_player.select_source (for example HDMI 1).
data_description.hidden: Keep the source configured but omit it from the TV source list.
data_description.interval: Seconds to wait after each press except the last.

data_description.name: Shown on media_player.select_source (for example HDMI 1).
data_description.hidden: Keep the source configured but omit it from the TV source list.
data_description.interval: Seconds to wait after each press except the last.
data_description.edit_sequence: Turn on to pick TV keys or button entities again and set how many times each is pressed.

source_seq_kind.title: Press sequence type
source_seq_kind.description:
Current sequence: {sequence}
Choose this TV's keys or Home Assistant button entities. You can add the other kind afterwards.

source_seq_pick.title: Choose presses
source_seq_pick.description:
Using {kind}. Current sequence: {sequence}
Pick items in the order they should be sent. Next you will set how many times each one is pressed.

data_description.actions: Drag to reorder. Each item is listed once; repeats are set on the next screen.

data_description.add_more: Turn on to append more TV keys or button entities after these.

source_delete.title: Delete input source
source_delete.description: Remove a source from the list. This cannot be undone after Save.

source_reorder.title: Reorder input sources
source_reorder.description: All input sources are listed. Drag to change the order shown on the media player. Keep every source in the list.

error.buttons_required: Select at least one TV key or button entity.
error.pick_required: Select at least one item of this type.
error.unknown_action: That press sequence has an unknown key or button.
error.command_required: Select or enter the IR command name.
error.device_required: This remote requires a device name.
error.name_in_use: That source name is already used.
error.unknown_source: That source is not in the list.
error.power_on_required: This power-on method needs the matching entity, IR command, or Wi-Fi MAC.
error.volume_button_invalid: Pick a button, switch, or script entity.
error.invalid_auth: 爱家 rejected the account or password.
error.aijia_connect: Could not reach 爱家 account servers.

send_key.name: Send remote key
send_key.description: Send a VIDAA / 爱家 KEY_* code to the TV.

key.name: Key
key.description: Wire name (KEY_HOME) or alias (home, ok, mute).

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Open by Android package via LAN 电视打开 (/..pushsmartju). After 爱家 login, browse media lists cloud 我的应用.

name.name: App name
name.description: Display name, for example 云视听极光.

url.name: App URL / package
url.description: Optional store url or Android package.

refresh_apps.name: Refresh my apps
refresh_apps.description: Reload 我的应用 from the 爱家 cloud when an account is logged in. Otherwise probe VIDAA MQTT applist.
